messages:
Emilia (CEO): Posting a consolidated follow-up for the reliability segment from today's all-hands. I've created this thread as the single source for questions, progress checks, and leadership responses. RCA (final draft): https://docs.redwood.com/rca/2026-03-ingress-throttle. Recording: https://zoom.redwood/rec/def. Please keep discussion here.

Sam (VP Eng): Short incident dossier: 35m service degradation caused by an autoscaler policy flip plus a cache TTL override introduced during a model rollout. Immediate mitigation: manual scale-up and rollback of quantized config.

Rohit (SRE Lead): RCA highlights uploaded. Timeline includes deploy events and alerts. Note: one log bucket was truncated in rotation; I'll attach the preserved slice by EOD. New alert created: infra:cache-ttl-regression (threshold: >3 ttl_override events/min).

Priya (Runtime): Rollback completed in the 02:00 UTC window. PR: rollback-config-pr-534 merged at 2026-03-29T02:08Z. Next step: gate the quantized flag behind a feature toggle and add CI validation to catch TTL overrides. I'll own both.

Jess (Customer Ops): Drafted a plain-language customer note and a spreadsheet of impacted accounts with assigned severity tiers. Draft link: https://docs.redwood.com/internal/cs/ingress-comm-v1. Would like Legal + Finance to review before send. ETA for final send: 2026-03-31 EOD.

Tara (Product): Product will map the severity buckets to roadmap items and propose deploy safety gates for model flag changes. I'll add "deploy safety gates" to the next sprint and include acceptance criteria.

Diego (Oncall): Oncall ran a 48h canary with enhanced tail-latency traces; dashboard snapshot: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/ingress/canary?panel=tail. Canary completed and stayed within SLOs. Posted the 48h export to the incident doc.

Lina (Docs): I'll produce a one-page postmortem summary for the handbook: what happened, key fixes, and a short checklist for safe rollouts (2-3 bullets). ETA: 2026-04-05.

Marta (Finance): I'll review the impacted accounts and the SLA language. If any contracts are triggered we'll calculate credits and loop Legal. Expect preliminary estimate within 48h after Jess posts the final impacted sheet.

ops-bot (deploy-bot): Deploy event: rollback-config-pr-534 merged by @Priya at 2026-03-29T02:08Z. Gating enhancement ticket created: #ENG-ops-flag-gate.

Legal-Bot (legal): Notified. Please @mention Legal-Bot on the final customer copy for review.

Rohit (SRE Lead): Action items recap (owners & due dates): 1) Rohit 1) attach missing log slice and finalize RCA by 2026-03-31 2) Priya 1) gate quantize flag + CI checks by 2026-04-06 3) Jess 1) finalize and send customer comms (Legal+Finance review) by 2026-03-31 EOD 4) Tara/Product 1) add deploy safety gates to roadmap by 2026-04-02 5) Diego/Oncall 1) complete 48h canary (done) and share telemetry link 6) Lina 1) produce onboarding one-pager by 2026-04-05. Please react when you close your item.

Sam (VP Eng): A couple of process notes: 1) we will implement a short change freeze window for model config rollouts on weekends until gates are in place 2) no direct edits to /etc/redwood/models/flags.yml in prod without a change review. We'll add a pre-deploy checklist to the deploy-bot that enforces these rules.

Jess (Customer Ops): Question for Leadership: should we proactively notify customers who saw brief latency versus waiting for inbound tickets? My recommendation is proactive for top-25 accounts. Thoughts?

Emilia (CEO): Proactive for top-25 and any account with legal/regulatory constraints. For the rest, prepare the copy and wait for CS to triage inbound unless Finance flags a contract implication.

Marta (Finance): Agrees with the CEO. I'll flag any accounts that meet credit thresholds so CS can prioritize sending notices.

Priya (Runtime): Technical note for engs: the TTL override shows up as "meta:ttl_override=true" in cache headers. Quick grep: kubectl logs -l app=ingress-cache -n prod | grep 'meta:ttl_override' -n -C2. Use staging copies where possible.

Rohit (SRE Lead): Added an automated smoke test in CI to detect TTL header anomalies. Also will add infra:cache-ttl-regression to the oncall runbook.

Tara (Product): Will coordinate with Priya on acceptance criteria for the deploy gate: (a) CI smoke pass for TTLs, (b) feature toggle present, (c) change review approved.

Diego (Oncall): Posting the canary 48h export link here: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/ingress/canary/export/48h. Metrics look stable and no tail spikes.

Lina (Docs): I'll include the canary snapshot in the handbook note.

Jess (Customer Ops): Will @Legal-Bot and @Marta on the final draft. Posting for review by EOD Tuesday.

Sam (VP Eng): Closing notes: please keep follow-ups in this thread. I will ping in 72h for a short status update on the action list and then close items that are marked done. Appreciate the fast cross-team execution today.

Emilia (CEO): Thanks everyone. Please react with :white_check_mark: in-thread when you complete your assigned tasks so we can close the loop. If leadership needs to approve comms, @Sam will sign off.

Rohit (SRE Lead): ack and attaching the missing log slice now to the RCA doc.

Priya (Runtime): ack. Starting the feature-flag gating work tonight.

Jess (Customer Ops): ack :+1: Draft posted for review.

Tara (Product): ack :clipboard: Added the ticket to the sprint backlog.

Diego (Oncall): ack :rocket: Canary complete and exported.

Lina (Docs): ack :memo: Will draft the one-pager.

Marta (Finance): ack. Will review impacted list when posted.
